molecular_inference.genome_type: nuclear ribosomal ITS and ETS, linked multicopy rDNA (not 350 independent low-copy genes)
molecular_inference.analysis: EAzami independent real NCBI-GenBank FASTA recovery; MAFFT per locus; IQ-TREE2 partitioned maximum likelihood, ModelFinder, UFBoot 1000, SH-aLRT 1000

original_shape_overlay.diagnostic: All observed strict-source U/D on this 67-tip rDNA tree are U. Do NOT claim U→D reversal or a global head-orientation climate test.
original_shape_overlay.missing_colour_handling: Original Siniscalchi CorollaColor source code 2 pools white/pink/purple; all unmatched source taxa retain blank/unknown.
original_shape_overlay.regional_notes: C. henryi and C. lineare are East Asian sample taxa with original Kelch source Hubei; several European source species are included but GenBank-only specimens may lack georeferenced voucher locality.

boundaries.genetic_effectiveness: Low-resolution nrDNA ITS/ETS must be sensitivity-checked against true multi-locus nuclear phylogenomics.
boundaries.nonindependent_species_specimens: Multiple individuals per taxon are not independent evolutionary origins.
